messages:
maya: quick heads-up — after the 5801 runtime rollout we're seeing a host-side parse delta on small requests. p95 up ~120ms, p50 stable. looks tied to fragment coalescing change.
ryan: ugh. which route/service?
maya: /v1/generate (small prompts, <128 tokens). heatmap shows spike at ingress parse + http2 writev.
ali: grabbing a quick profile now. can we get a sample trace from the node that hit 0.9 QPS?
perf-bot: alert: host_parse_latency.p95 > 100ms for service /v1/generate (host-03) — triggered at 2026-03-17T14:21:07Z :rotating_light:
ryan: thanks. side-by-side flame from before/after would help. if kv-cache miss rate increased we might be doing extra proto unpacking per chunk.
ali: paste of perf sample:```
# before (canary off)
parse_ms: 18
http2_writev_calls: 4
kv_cache_miss: 2.3%
cpu_us: 12%

# after (canary on)
parse_ms: 132
http2_writev_calls: 12
kv_cache_miss: 6.9%
cpu_us: 28%
```
maya: whoa parse_ms 18 -> 132. that matches the p95. http2 writev tripled.
ryan: writev jump suggests more fragmented frames being emitted. maybe the proto coalesce window got narrower. any kernel selection changes?
maya: no kernel swap in this deploy. only changed the ingress chunker to try to reduce tail for long requests. new config: `ingress.coalesce_ms = 4` (was 12ms).
ali: that would make small requests send more smaller frames -> writev up -> syscall overhead. also KV cache keys depend on framing alignment; more fragments => lower KV hits.
ryan: can we revert ingress.coalesce_ms to 12ms in prod canary and see?
maya: rolling rollback on canary now.
ops-bot: deploy rollback started for runtime-canary/5801 by maya — 1 instance at a time.
ali: also putting a microprof patch to avoid re-tokenizing on each fragment boundary (cheap mem view instead). small change, will open PR.
ryan: nice. in parallel we should add a lightweight metric: `ingress.fragment_rate` and `kvcache.effective_hit` per route. helps correlate.
maya: agreed. adding to console dashboards and a short eval to catch this kind of regression.
ali: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4521 — microparse: reuse tokenizer slice across fragments, unit tests included.
ryan: thanks. if rollback fixes it we'll schedule patch release tomorrow. if not, we'll bisect further into kernel/path.
maya: rollback finished on canary — initial p95 back to ~22ms on the canary host. will watch the rollout. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: resolved: host_parse_latency.p95 returned to normal for /v1/generate (host-03).
ali: follow-up: opened ticket RT-2893 to add fragment-level kv cache telemetry and an e2e harness for small prompts.
ryan: good. postmortem short note tomorrow with numbers and recommendations (dont narrow coalesce window for small prompt routes).
maya: thanks all — close the loop when PR merges.
